tenancy.member_added.v1.description:
A member joined (``add_member``, an accepted invitation, a new owner).

Ordering: delivery is at-least-once and unordered, and ``version`` is
optional within ``.v1`` (a tenancy still on an older release publishes
none during a rolling upgrade). Decide per event: ``version`` present:
apply it when it is newer than the version you stored (or you stored
none), else skip it; ``version`` absent: refresh, re-reading
``tenancy.membership.v1.get_member_state(organization_id, user_id)`` (role
and version in one statement) and storing that unless it is older than
what you stored.
tenancy.member_added.v1.title: MemberAdded

tenancy.member_added.v2.description:
A member joined (v2).

The organization is ``tenant_id`` (a consumer binds it; a projection's
``tenant_from``). ``version`` is required and per ``(organization_id,
user_id)``: order and dedupe by it (a projection's ``version_field``).
Published with the v1 channel in one unit.

role.description: member, admin or owner; absent on member_removed.

version.description: Per (organization_id, user_id), monotonic over the membership's whole lifecycle: order and dedupe by it.
